reason: The supplied evidence shows that several earlier wrapper and kernel changes failed the fixed promotion gate, so none of these proposals has a measured speedup. I rank the verified TB descriptor path first because it removes the generated B packing path, though its timed 1 MiB A transpose and added A packing may erase that benefit. assembly_audit proposes the same TB mapping and conversion, so it is an alias, not independent evidence. Fusing A transpose with packing could remove full-scratch traffic, but the supplied source does not specify how to feed a tile to MOPA without extra copies, changed K order, or repeated transpose work; keep it experimental and count any repeated conversion in the timed cost. The remaining proposals add full input conversions or change scratch, traversal, or store order with uncertain benefit. The 160 KiB cache-layout proposal exceeds the supplied 128 KiB P-core L1D size, and cache indexing details are unavailable. Advice and rankings are hypotheses, not measured results.
